1. (Currently Amended) A preventing or treating agent for glaucoma comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof, wherein the agent is used in subjects with elevated intraocular pressure or a family history of glaucoma.

2. (Currently Amended) A preventing or treating agent for ocular hypertension comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof, wherein the agent reduces intraocular pressure below baseline levels.

3. (Currently Amended) A composition for eye drops comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof and a pharmaceutically accepted carrier, wherein the composition is formulated for treating elevated intraocular pressure.

7. (Currently Amended) A method for treating glaucoma wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered to a subject having glaucoma or elevated intraocular pressure.

8. (Currently Amended) A method for treating ocular hypertension wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered to a subject having elevated intraocular pressure.

9. (Previously Presented) A method for treating glaucoma comprising administering (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof to a subject in need thereof.

10. (Previously Presented) A method for treating ocular hypertention comprising administering (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof to a subject in need thereof.

11. (Currently Amended) A method for enhancing an intraocular pressure-reducing action of (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or its salt in a subject with elevated intraocular pressure, wherein phosphoric acid or a salt thereof is combined with (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof.

12. (Previously Presented) A method for reducing intraocular pressure from the normal level, which method comprises administering a combination of (S)-(-)-l-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine, or its salt, and phosphoric acid, or a salt thereof, to a person having normal intraocular pressure.
